title: 2026 fishing opportunities in Atlantic waters
subtitle: Implementing decision — no member state vote
voteRuleLabel: Commission implementing act — adopted without a member state vote
summary: The Commission set the 2026 catch limits for Atlantic stocks under the delegated powers in the Common Fisheries Policy. There is no country-by-country vote on an act like this — which is exactly why the national impact and the national press reaction are the only country-level record there is.
whatItMeans: Catch limits apply from 1 February 2026 across Atlantic and North Sea stocks.
No member state cast a vote: the act rests on powers already delegated to the Commission.
National fleets feel the effect unevenly — the map shows where.

outcome.headline: Adopted by the Commission — no vote taken.
